def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        col=grid[r][c]
        if col==0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
        st=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); pts=[]
        while st:
          x,y=st.pop(); pts.append((x,y))
          for a,b in ((x+1,y),(x-1,y),(x,y+1),(x,y-1)):
            if 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and (a,b) not in seen and grid[a][b]==col:
              seen.add((a,b));st.append((a,b))
        comps.append((col,pts))
    def forms(p):
      out=set()
      for flip in (-1,1):
       for rot in range(4):
        q=[]
        for x,y in p:
         x,y=x*flip,y
         for _ in range(rot): x,y=y,-x
         q.append((x,y))
        a=min(x for x,y in q); b=min(y for x,y in q)
        out.add(frozenset((x-a,y-b) for x,y in q))
      return out
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Among same-size congruent shapes, select nearest color object; shapes of 1s are recolored.
    for col,p in comps:
      if col!=1: continue
      candidates=[]
      for oc,op in comps:
       if oc==1 or len(op)!=len(p): continue
       if forms(p)&forms(op):
        dist=min(abs(x-a)+abs(y-b) for x,y in p for a,b in op)
        candidates.append((dist,oc))
      if candidates:
       target=min(candidates)[1]
       for x,y in p: out[x][y]=target
    return out
